agentContract.composition: Import named components from @spfx-fast/sharepoint-ui/react. Put one SharePointUIProvider around the view. Compose with children by default; use only the slots and component props listed for that component.
agentContract.state: State props, initial default props, callback names, and callback arguments vary by component. Follow that component's signature and callbackProps; update controlled state in its callback.
agentContract.customElements: Import the component's define function from @spfx-fast/sharepoint-ui/elements/{module} and register it once. Set objects and callbacks as DOM properties. For event names and statically visible detail keys, use the source module's event inventory at https://vystartasv.github.io/sharepoint-ui/agents/events/{module}.json; it is module-scoped, so check event.target when composed tags emit events. Where present, a component JSON slice reports its tag's statically declared observed attributes as customElementAttributes; set non-attribute objects and callbacks as DOM properties.

elementEventInventory.scope: source module; composed child tags may also emit listed events

api.reactSignature: { children, content, mountNode, placement = "top", positioning, align, offset, appearance = "normal", relationship = "description", disabled = false, open, visible, delay, showDelay, hideDelay, withArrow = false, onOpenChange, onVisibleChange, ...props }: TooltipProps

component.summary: Provide delayed hover/focus help with label, description, or inaccessible relationships; portal the surface to a custom mountNode while keeping the trigger in place; supports theme appearances, controlled visibility, arrows, and Fluent-compatible fallback, boundary, sizing, target, offset, and positioning-ref options.
